# What Typeform personal access tokens the library redacts, and what it leaves
# alone. Typeform writes one prefix for this credential, tfp_, and the body
# behind it is read as a floor of forty letters, digits and underscores, run on
# to wherever that run ends: the sources this format rests on disagree on its
# width, so a body has none of its own to stop at.
#
# That reading is what the last group of cases is about. A token written against
# more of the alphabet is redacted together with what it was written against,
# because nothing in the text divides the two; ordinary punctuation ends a run
# and is left alone.
#
# Every token here is built from the ordered run
# 0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz, which no real credential is: that run and
# 0123 behind it come to a body of forty. The case written in uppercase carries a
# run of its own instead, the digits and then the uppercase letters ascending,
# since the run above holds no uppercase letter.

patterns: typeform-personal-access-token

# The places a token is written: the environment a script reads it from, the
# header Typeform's documentation passes it in, the command that documentation
# makes its first request with, and a response body carrying one.

case:     a token in an environment assignment
in:       TYPEFORM_TOKEN=tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      TYPEFORM_TOKEN=«typeform-personal-access-token»

case:     a token in a bearer header
in:       Authorization: Bearer tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      Authorization: Bearer «typeform-personal-access-token»

case:     a token in the command that makes a first request
in:       curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123' https://api.typeform.com/me
out:      curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer «typeform-personal-access-token»' https://api.typeform.com/me

case:     a token in json
in:       {"token":"tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123"}
out:      {"token":"«typeform-personal-access-token»"}

case:     a token between tabs
in:       field\ttfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123\tnext
out:      field\t«typeform-personal-access-token»\tnext

case:     a token followed by crlf
in:       TYPEFORM_TOKEN=tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123\r\n
out:      TYPEFORM_TOKEN=«typeform-personal-access-token»\r\n

# Bodies the alphabet admits that the run above does not reach: an underscore
# inside one, which is the shape Typeform's own detection rule reads, and the
# uppercase letters.

case:     a body divided by an underscore
in:       TYPEFORM_TOKEN=tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123_456789ab
out:      TYPEFORM_TOKEN=«typeform-personal-access-token»

case:     a body of uppercase letters
in:       TYPEFORM_TOKEN=tfp_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123
out:      TYPEFORM_TOKEN=«typeform-personal-access-token»

# What the floor costs and what bounds it. A token standing in front of more of
# the alphabet is redacted to the end of that run, since the body has no width to
# end at; a character outside the alphabet ends the run and stays in the text.

case:     a word joined to a token by an underscore
in:       tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123_suffix
out:      «typeform-personal-access-token»

case:     a token at the end of a sentence
in:       the token is tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123.
out:      the token is «typeform-personal-access-token».

case:     a token in a query string
in:       ?token=tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123&page=2
out:      ?token=«typeform-personal-access-token»&page=2

# What the pattern leaves alone: a body short of the floor, the prefix written in
# another case or with another separator, and the vendor's own name, which
# carries the byte the scan searches the input for.

case:     a body one character short of the floor
in:       TYPEFORM_TOKEN=tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012
out:      TYPEFORM_TOKEN=tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012

case:     an uppercase prefix
in:       TYPEFORM_TOKEN=TFP_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      TYPEFORM_TOKEN=TFP_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

case:     a hyphen where the prefix carries its underscore
in:       TYPEFORM_TOKEN=tfp-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123
out:      TYPEFORM_TOKEN=tfp-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123

case:     a body broken by a space
in:       TYPEFORM_TOKEN=tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy 0123
out:      TYPEFORM_TOKEN=tfp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy 0123

case:     the vendor's name in a url
in:       GET https://api.typeform.com/forms/abc123/responses
out:      GET https://api.typeform.com/forms/abc123/responses

case:     prose naming the credential
in:       generate a personal access token from your account settings
out:      generate a personal access token from your account settings
